cards.p: If the first keeps $12 per unit after fees and costs, that is profitable. If the second keeps $8, every unit loses money.
This product breaks even at 39.98%, not at 10%. A seller running it at 30% ACOS and worrying is making money and worrying anyway.
At 55% ACOS this product loses $4.50 on every unit advertising sells, and selling more units makes the loss larger, not smaller.
ACOS is 30.0% in all three months and reports that nothing changed. TACOS falls from 24.0% to 10.0% and reports that the business became far less dependent on advertising.
